Body.Content:
Azure Bastion Premium is a new SKU to target customers handling highly sensitive virtual machine workloads. Its mission is to offer enhanced security features that ensure customer virtual machines are connected securely and to monitor VMs for any anomalies that may arise. Our first set of features will focus on ensuring private connectivity and graphical recordings of virtual machines connected through Bastion.   

With the new Azure Bastion Premium SKU, you can now perform/configure the following: 

  • Record all virtual machine sessions that are connected via a session-recording Bastion. View the configure session recording. 

  • Connect to Bastion via a private endpoint. Learn to configure this setting. 

We will continue to roll out new functionalities for Bastion Premium SKU in the coming months, so stay tuned. 

Learn more.
